skill_name: Write a summary about the D-DAY Invasion.
workflow: The D-Day Invasion was the largest seaborne invasion in history, taking place on June 6th, 1944. It was the Allies' plan to break through German defenses in Normandy, France, in order to gain access to Central Europe and ultimately bring an end to World War II. Over 156,000 troops from the United States, Britain, Canada and other Allied countries took part in the invasion.
